decision: Approve the three HomeTemplate naming conventions with their exact scoped meanings.

evidence.interpretation: Separate naming approval bound to spec payload 622eacf3cccb774690b6c247dcaf6e31a8feb4aa858376b00fd274438dc8eb84. No unrelated migration or native review authority.

convention.name: zoneTable
convention.whenToUse: Supply the authoritative ordered zones for scroll choreography.
convention.avoid: Do not use for preview guide rectangles or a current-section identity.

convention.name: zone
convention.meaning: Bind a rendered HomeTemplateAnchor to its configured zone key.
convention.whenToUse: Associate an anchor box with its configured choreography zone.
convention.avoid: Do not use for the active zone identity or a table of zones.

convention.name: onZoneChange
convention.meaning: Notify initial/current active-zone identity changes, not per-frame progress.
convention.whenToUse: Notify consumers when the active choreography zone identity is first resolved or changes.
convention.avoid: Do not use for continuous per-frame progress or a consumer-selected current section.
